question: Should the schema-v4-to-v6 database migration and expanded portable-store contract ship based on the focused exact-head tests, or require copied v0.7.1 store upgrade proof first?
rationale: Code inspection supports the migration mechanics, but the acceptable release-proof threshold for persisted user archives is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept focused tests
options.body: Approve this head because its targeted migration, portable-store, hydration, fallback, and transition-history fixtures sufficiently cover the release contract.

options.title: Require copied-store proof
options.body: Hold merge until copied v0.7.1 database and portable stores show redacted before-and-after doctor, coverage, summarize, and cluster output.

recommendation.title: Accept focused tests
recommendation.body: Approve this head because its targeted migration, portable-store, hydration, fallback, and transition-history fixtures sufficiently cover the release contract.

likelyOwner.reason: His v0.7.1 release commit owns the current-main storage and sync baseline and he is best positioned to set the release compatibility threshold.
